_notes: Verbs: PUT = create, POST = update, DELETE = delete.

Dates: RFC 3339 / ISO 8601. Vikunja stores and returns timestamps as absolute instants (UTC); send an explicit offset or 'Z'. The server's default timezone (service.timezone, default GMT) and the per-user timezone setting only affect filters, reminders and repeating tasks, not the stored value.
Task 'labels' in the task body is read-only; labels are attached through separate endpoints. Labels must exist first (create_label).
Update (POST /tasks/{id}) can reset omitted fields: GET the task first and send the full object.

body.title: Review quarterly report
body.description: Created from a screenshot by vikunja-assistant.

add_labels_to_task._note: Replaces ALL labels on the task with the given set.

set_task_done._note: Include current title so it is not reset; ideally send the full GET /tasks/{id} object with done=true.
